intended_object: The stationary (A-harmonic, energy-minimising) extension operator. It takes boundary/endpoint data Y ∈ U, forms a trial lift L Y, and corrects it by the unique element of the closed zero-trace subspace S that makes the result A-orthogonal to S. Equivalently, it is the oblique projection along S applied after L. Inferred from the docstring, the module docstring ("endpoint Schur complement of a coercive quadratic form … stationary extension"), and its use in endpointOperator / dirichletToNeumann.
